Fj Capital Management Increased Its Evans Bancorp (EVBN) Holding; Mu Investments Has Trimmed Apple Computer (AAPL) Holding by $1.33 Million 
April 20, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Fj Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Evans Bancorp Inc (EVBN) by 14.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fj Capital Management Llc bought 20,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.66% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 168,900 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.08M, up from 148,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fj Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Evans Bancorp Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $215.92 million market cap company. The stock increased 1.69% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $45.1. About 4,519 shares traded. Evans Bancorp, Inc. (NYSEMKT:EVBN) has risen 15.30% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.75% the S&P500. 
Mu Investments decreased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 19.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mu Investments sold 7,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 33,130 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.67M, down from 40,930 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mu Investments who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $846.60 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.44% or $5.95 during the last trading session, reaching $166.85. About 32.76M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
